## [1.1.0](https://github.com/ratatabananana-bit/gaming-hub-morphe-patches/compare/v1.0.0...v1.1.0) (2026-10-24)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* answer GOS game list at the shared request helper ([fc4a034](https://github.com/ratatabananana-bit/gaming-hub-morphe-patches/commit/fc4a03472496ba1b12818449dff3689b1ac69aeb))
* answer Instant Plays summary locally and throttle skipped retries ([1ecee10](https://github.com/ratatabananana-bit/gaming-hub-morphe-patches/commit/1ecee1016f3650df844ae5efc5a6a0b28feb5cae))
* build Retrofit responses without the removed success factory ([10b90e5](https://github.com/ratatabananana-bit/gaming-hub-morphe-patches/commit/10b90e5329c27109ddcf0dd6000cd66a1981a9e5))

* keep the Library header filled across layout passes ([3768632](https://github.com/ratatabananana-bit/gaming-hub-morphe-patches/commit/37686323f62b67647fd05e5411f0a71c307e1d86))

* match GOS result check on Collection.isEmpty ([bdef0fa](https://github.com/ratatabananana-bit/gaming-hub-morphe-patches/commit/bdef0fa4966b751f56170c8efe700a04a5f3660d))
* remove the empty strip under the Library header ([9091e1b](https://github.com/ratatabananana-bit/gaming-hub-morphe-patches/commit/9091e1b8362532e59ce5786d3cffc739d245f89f))
* replace GOS response before the helper's null check ([bee8ac0](https://github.com/ratatabananana-bit/gaming-hub-morphe-patches/commit/bee8ac0e605eea13dabf79fc5b4ffd882eced645))
* resolve My games fingerprints inside the patch context ([6772462](https://github.com/ratatabananana-bit/gaming-hub-morphe-patches/commit/67724624da404c56f465d77f0a7464cbfe9c3e3a))
* resolve startup status by enum name instead of obfuscated field ([9c3decb](https://github.com/ratatabananana-bit/gaming-hub-morphe-patches/commit/9c3decb1a06668a043a97df9e93a4b647f830002))
* skip startup onboarding when no Samsung account is visible ([a2d0ac0](https://github.com/ratatabananana-bit/gaming-hub-morphe-patches/commit/a2d0ac0144df536384c79743a347ac8d50d96172))
* stretch the Library header to the app bar's minimum height ([7a50053](https://github.com/ratatabananana-bit/gaming-hub-morphe-patches/commit/7a5005367ee9d74a467d8a04c57535060b2f81cb))

### ✨ New Features

* add experimental patch to skip mandatory sign-in ([e20e84e](https://github.com/ratatabananana-bit/gaming-hub-morphe-patches/commit/e20e84e30bed5f6bdb4232b65163928c39b9c341))
* compute play history on the device ([323fb47](https://github.com/ratatabananana-bit/gaming-hub-morphe-patches/commit/323fb474bd46713560690e3bd08ffc4f40ad87ee))
* hide Instant Plays history section in My games ([5aad1a3](https://github.com/ratatabananana-bit/gaming-hub-morphe-patches/commit/5aad1a32a003c59d26d859738cda5a5bfdd4552e))
* hide Popular Instant Plays categories row ([81c1222](https://github.com/ratatabananana-bit/gaming-hub-morphe-patches/commit/81c12220b14e6006e9d3433861ec4c0fd2683071))
* restore local features without a Samsung account ([d208f5a](https://github.com/ratatabananana-bit/gaming-hub-morphe-patches/commit/d208f5a763639940af4345b76659ab7934852a2e))

patches.name: Hide Events button
patches.description: Removes the gift icon in the top right of the home screen that opens the Events page.

patches.name: Hide Instant Plays history
patches.description: Removes the Instant Plays history section from the top of My games.

patches.name: Hide Popular Instant Plays categories
patches.description: Removes the "Popular Instant Plays categories" row from the home screen.

patches.name: Hide Recommended for you
patches.description: Removes the "Recommended for you" row from the home screen.

options.description: Title of the row to hide, as shown in the app. Separate alternative titles (for example other languages) with '|'.

patches.name: Hide Top instant plays
patches.description: Removes the "Top instant plays" row from the home screen.

options.description: Title of the row to hide, as shown in the app. Separate alternative titles (for example other languages) with '|'.

patches.name: Local play history
patches.description: Experimental. Shows your play history in the gamer profile, computed on the device from Android's usage data instead of Samsung's server, and stops account-only requests to Samsung's server that fail without a Samsung account. Requires usage data access for Gaming Hub in Android settings.

patches.name: Skip mandatory sign-in
patches.description: Experimental. Opens Gaming Hub without the mandatory Samsung account sign-in. Required for any patched Gaming Hub, because Samsung account sign-in only works with the original Samsung signature. Features that need an account will not work.

patches.name: Use Android game list
patches.description: Fills My games with installed apps that Android marks as games. Required for any patched Gaming Hub, because Samsung's game service refuses apps that are not signed by Samsung.
